actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The package's model is the MJCF scene unitree_robots/h2/scene.xml, whose root element is '<mujoco model="Unitree H2">' and which includes h2_mujoco.xml
h2_mujoco.xml declares '<compiler angle="radian" meshdir="meshes/"/>', so the joint ranges and the control ranges of the model are radians and its meshes are resolved from meshes/
The model sets the integration step to 0.001 s
The model's floating base is the joint floating_base_joint of type free
The actuator block has 31 <motor> elements, one per actuated hinge joint, and every motor states a ctrlrange
The leg motors state ctrlrange +-360 for the hip pitch, hip roll, hip yaw and knee, +-19 for the ankle roll and +-66.88 for the ankle pitch
The waist motors state ctrlrange +-120 for the waist yaw and +-180 for the waist roll and waist pitch
The arm motors state ctrlrange +-130 for the shoulder pitch, +-60 for the shoulder roll, shoulder yaw, elbow and wrist roll, and +-10 for the wrist pitch and wrist yaw
The head motors state ctrlrange +-50 for the head pitch and head yaw
The left hip pitch joint has range -2.4526 to 2.77542 rad
The left ankle roll joint has range -0.349066 to 0.296706 rad
The left wrist pitch joint has range -0.576 to 0.576 rad
The repository describes itself as a simulator developed based on Unitree sdk2 and mujoco
The unitree_robots directory holds the MJCF description files for the robots supported by unitree_sdk2
The Python simulator loads the scene with mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path and creates the MjData
The Python simulator overrides the model timestep with config.SIMULATE_DT
config.py sets SIMULATE_DT to 0.005 s
UnitreeSdk2Bridge reads num_motor from mj_model.nu and its step from mj_model.opt.timestep
UnitreeSdk2Bridge maps a Unitree LowCmd motor command to data.ctrl as tau + kp*(q - sensordata) + kd*(dq - sensordata)
The Python simulator publishes and subscribes the DDS topics rt/lowcmd, rt/lowstate and rt/sportmodestate
The Python simulator needs unitree_sdk2_python and mujoco-python, installed with pip3

determinism.notes: MuJoCo integrates one model deterministically from one initial state; the bridge's cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults (mj_resetData plus mj_forward) and takes no seed parameter, so no seed selects a different state; this package's fake is a placeholder integrator and was not compared with MuJoCo

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the scene and its include for the joint and actuator counts, the ctrlrange of each motor and the 1 ms model timestep, but integrates a placeholder torque response and resolves no mesh, texture, contact, constraint, gravity, inertia or sensor

MuJoCo was not installed and cannot be installed where the gate ran (no network, no pip), so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine; the sim path (a backend name backends does not list, which imports the real mujoco module) was not run

the upstream Python simulator overrides the model timestep with config.SIMULATE_DT = 0.005 s (simulate_python/unitree_mujoco.py:31, simulate_python/config.py:13) and maps Unitree LowCmd messages into data.ctrl (simulate_python/unitree_sdk2py_bridge.py:111-123); this driver loads the scene directly, keeps the model's 0.001 s step and exposes data.ctrl, so it is not the upstream DDS simulator
no viewer, joystick, DDS channel or unitree_sdk2py message is modelled; the package is a local MuJoCo world, not the upstream simulate_python loop and not a physical robot
snapshot and restore use the bridge's fallback state (time, qpos, qvel, ctrl) because the fake implements no mj_getState/mj_setState; the H2 scene adds no act, mocap or keyframe state beyond that

the fake's free-base reset starts at the pelvis body position (0 0 1.2) and identity quaternion; it does not run MuJoCo's qpos0 or forward kinematics, and its step does not clamp the joints to their model ranges

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
